item.title: Pakistan court gives Muslim kidnapper custody of 13-year-old Christian girl
item.description: A federal court in Pakistan has given custody of a 13-year-old Christian girl to a Muslim man who kidnapped and forcibly converted and married her. #Pakistan #Christiangirl #kidnapping #forcedconversion

item.title: Savannah Guthrie calls mom ‘God's precious daughter,' pleads to alleged kidnappers for proof of life
item.description: A distraught Savannah Guthrie called her missing mother, Nancy Guthrie, “God’s precious daughter” in a heart-wrenching appeal on Wednesday. The "Today" show co-host also addressed her mother’s alleged kidnappers, saying her family is ready to talk about a ransom, but not before they have proof their mother is alive. #SavannahGuthrie #NancyGuthrie #Ransom #Missing #Arizona

item.title: Mike Johnson says 'borders are biblical,' responds to Pope Leo's criticism of Trump policies
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., has responded to Pope Leo XIV’s concerns about President Donald Trump’s immigration policies, proclaiming that “borders are biblical.” #PopeLeoXIV #CatholicChurch #MikeJohnson #DonaldTrump #Immigration #Illegalimmigration

item.title: Texas school district blames 'procedural breakdown' after student reveals Islamic group distributed Qurans, hijabs on campus
item.description: A Texas school district is blaming a “failure to follow established procedures” after a Muslim outreach group with ties to anti-Christian ideology distributed Islamic materials to students at one of its high schools. #Texas #Islam #Quran #hijab #WylieISD

item.title: World Vision calls for urgent assistance in DRC after landslide killed over 200
item.description: The Evangelical humanitarian organization World Vision is pleading for humanitarian assistance following a recent landslide in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which claimed over 200 lives and an estimated 70 children. #WorldVision #UnitedNations #Naturaldisaster #DemocraticRepublicoftheCongo #Landslide #Kivu

item.title: Super Bowl LX: 6 Christians playing in the big game
item.description: The New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks have multiple players who publicly embrace their Christian faith and have not hesitated to praise Jesus both on and off the field. Here are six Christians who will be suiting up to play in Super Bowl LX at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. #SuperBowlLX #NFL #SeattleSeahawks #NewEnglandPatriots #TreVeyonHenderson #DrakeMaye #StefonDiggs #JaxonSmithNjigba #ErnestJones #CooperKupp

item.title: Gov. Bill Lee shares how his faith guided him after wife's death, how he first met Jelly Roll at Nat'l Prayer Breakfast
item.description: At the 74th annual National Prayer Breakfast on Thursday morning, Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee shared how his Christian faith helped him get through the suffering and grief that he and his children felt following the tragic death of his wife. #BillLee #JellyRoll #NationalPrayerBreakfast #faith #tragedy #Tennessee #governor #Trump

item.title: 6 times top Democrats warned against illegal immigration, called for deportations
item.description: Many of the same Democratic politicians who now rail against aspects of President Donald Trump's federal immigration enforcement once warned against the consequences of unrestrained illegal immigration. #BillClinton #HillaryClinton #BarackObama #ChuckSchumer #NancyPelosi #illegalimmigration #ICE

item.title: Seahawks coach declares 'our identity is in Christ' ahead of Super Bowl, gave players Bibles
item.description: The coaches and chaplain for the Seattle Seahawks have opened up about the vital role the Christian faith plays for their team heading into Super Bowl LX against the New England Patriots on Sunday, with one coach who bought everyone on the team a Bible insisting, “our identity is in Christ.” #SuperBowlLX #SeattleSeahawks #NationalFootballLeague #Spor

item.title: Trump touts religion, attacks political opponents at National Prayer Breakfast: 'You have to believe'
item.description: President Donald Trump said "religion is coming back" in the United States and touted his administration's accomplishments for religious liberty while attacking his political opponents during a wide-ranging speech at the National Prayer Breakfast in Washington, D.C., on Thursday. #DonaldTrump #NationalPrayerBreakfast #ThomasMassie #ChipRoy
